alt_title: Jan Dhan: ₹5,390 per Account on Average, Every State on the Map
description: India's 59.54 crore Jan Dhan accounts hold ₹3.21 lakh crore (PMJDY portal, as on 7 Oct 2026). That is about ₹5,390 per account on average, our calculation, and the average includes accounts with little or no balance.
Lakshadweep has the highest average (₹18,437, on 11,027 accounts) and Manipur the lowest (₹2,823). Every state and union territory is on the map. 33.20 crore accounts are held by women.
